# GetChannelBus <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
GetChannelBus:Int32 channel:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel` | In | Int32 | required | A channel handle from [PlaySound](PlaySound), [PlayMusic](PlayMusic) or [EmitSound](EmitSound). |

**Returns:** The bus, `0` for the master bus and for a channel that is over.

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Tells the bus that a channel plays on. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print GetChannelBus(ch)
```
